title: Great community!
author: Jeduin
selftext:
Im reading so many good things about this community, I've been showing my game that I've made with claude off in many reddit communities and received so much negativity that I was hesitant to share my game. 

Lovely to see that there are communities that share positivity! Can't wait to show my game here and receive actual feedback rather than a simple "AI-slop" message.

Keep up the good work! 😁❤️

comments.author: Useful_Use_6170
comments.body: hurry up and share your slop!! I wanna play it!!

replies.author: Jeduin
replies.body: Haha, I'll share it tonight! But Its still in (alpha open testing)

replies.author: Jeduin
replies.body: Its an RPG hero collecting game, but with different game modes then you normally see.

replies.author: Useful_Use_6170
replies.body: Ok Mr I got all the feedback ready for ya

replies.author: Useful_Use_6170
replies.body: DM me, so I can share in private or discord

comments.author: YuukiCrypto
comments.body: There is a saying "be the change you want to see in the world". I realized I could remain bitter that the world is being stupid about AI. OR i can just ignore them and live in the world I want to live in where people aren't so anal about their "ideas".  We all gotta die, people gotta stop acting like they're gods or immortal...

comments.author: International_Back30
comments.body:
Share your game buddy. 

I've built something with Claude and codex and it's the most fun I've had building a game and it's received some heat which has made me more determined. Would love to see what you've built.

replies.author: International_Back30
replies.body: Hey mate I gave a little go. I'm impressed. Well done! It does not look AI. Keep going!

replies.author: Jeduin
replies.body: Thank you very much! I really appreciate the nice words!

replies.body: This is FFH I made a realy big reddit post on this reddit.

replies.body: Sorry for being dull. What does FFH mean?

replies.body: Ignore me. I've just got it! Fate Forged Heroes.
